import sys, unittest
excluded = set(["test_concurrency_probe.ConcurrencyProbeTests.test_metrics_count_reasoning_and_measure_concurrent_makespan","test_concurrency_probe.ConcurrencyProbeTests.test_one_pre_stream_reset_retry_keeps_submit_latency","test_concurrency_probe.ConcurrencyProbeTests.test_prefill_overlap_reports_the_decode_gap_not_created_event_ttft","test_concurrency_probe.ConcurrencyProbeTests.test_short_decode_is_submitted_one_second_into_prefill_with_vram_samples"])
def flatten(suite):
    for item in suite:
        if isinstance(item, unittest.TestSuite):
            yield from flatten(item)
        else:
            yield item
all_tests = list(flatten(unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests')))
selected = unittest.TestSuite(t for t in all_tests if t.id() not in excluded)
print('Discovered:', len(all_tests), 'selected:', selected.countTestCases(), flush=True)
print('Documented local timing exclusions:', *sorted(excluded), sep='\n', flush=True)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(selected)
sys.exit(not result.wasSuccessful())
